cohort.selection: Both expression classes required; unchanged boundary-only hash/rule-balanced up to two per class; first 80 eligible IDs in complete ascending eight-attempt waves. Retain every rejected and surplus attempt.

qualification.fixture: -8,-7 are ineligible; -6 has4 rows, -5 has3 with a singleton pass class; remaining4 are eligible surplus. Synthetic packets use existing fixed fixture.

analysis.weights: Equal acquisition block, equal current_pass class, equal packet within class, equal individual squared losses across four futures.
analysis.joint: All four equal-read primary lower limits strictly exceed zero. Direct8 and TT008 remain mandatory descriptive secondary contrasts; no all-eight claim. Individual intervals are not simultaneous.
analysis.diagnostics: Weighted calibration in ten fixed bins and additive loss mass by history and current expression; no subgroup gate.

seed_contract.adapter: acquisition.namespace, selection.namespace, forcing.namespace, forcing.future_namespace := scope namespace + /acquisition, /selection, /probe, /future
seed_contract.pairing: Regime omitted from seed; same base forcing and injuries, matched copies cue0 into cue1. Independent futures distinguished by replicate stage; distinct probe/future namespaces. Each regime propagates its own packets.

endpoint: 18 exact rewrites g15..32 from g14, followed by fresh g33 test. All4 task-aligned last32 port means strictly>.25. Earlier failures do not stop the path.
forecast_barrier: Independently verify all five fixed forecasts and their measurement evidence over the complete selected cohort, then seal them before any continuation. No fit or recalibration.
claim_boundary: Ordinary forecasting in a selected fresh-founder panel; no RDT-specific law, endogenous maintenance or repair-benefit scheduler. Historical failed selectors/reductions remain failed.
planning_limits: Development-selected model/domain, effect-size uncertainty, projected repeat variance and non-Gaussian block gains limit power predictions. The SD inflation is a sensitivity, not an exact confidence bound for the variance-component model. Full-cap runtime forecast 21259.318152130087 seconds; fixed 136-attempt cap can prevent complete acquisition. No inference for an incomplete cohort.
launch: Qualification cannot launch science. A later explicit scientific invocation requires a matching successful frozen qualification and fresh CPU admission; no automatic successor.

resource_basis.claim_boundary: Fresh conditional forecast superiority at equal native-read budgets would be useful forecasting evidence. It would not uniquely establish RDT, endogenous maintenance or a repair-benefit scheduler.

unchanged: All five fixed predictors and coefficients
Both noise regimes and native endpoint
Four equal-read primary contrasts, alpha and margins
Full-cohort forecast barrier and complete-only inference
amendment.reason: Retain the shortest original complete-cohort design. Select the largest complete eight-attempt cap no greater than its original cap that leaves at least 300 seconds inside six hours, retaining every measured phase maximum and the 1.5 multiplier.
